note: I8's oracles: MMC3 (mapper 4) test ROMs and one homebrew program on MMC3. Fetched by hash into roms/cache/ (gitignored), never committed (Decided: oracle ROMs are fetched by hash; roms/LICENSES.md records each one's terms). Read by cases/i8_support.py. Holy Mapperel's MMC3 builds (and its mapper-118 build, for the refusal) are cut from the same pinned v0.02 release archive I6 and I7 use: each ROM is a slice of the archive's second raw LZMA2 block, pinned by its own SHA-256. blargg's mmc3_test_2 singles come from christopherpow/nes-test-roms at the corpus's pinned commit; nesdoug's 33_MMC3 demo from its repository at a pinned commit.
